# PwEevee 3.1.0 — Major Feature Release

PwEevee 3.1.0 is a major feature release focused on performance, customization, lyrics, lock-screen improvements, audio features, and downloads. Built around Spotify **9.1.90**, this release brings together requested features, improvements from the Vitrine project, and Pixie Download Manager's native Spotify offline-download functionality.

## Downloads

- **PwEevee 3.1.0** — `PwEevee-3.1.0.ipa` (140.23 MB)  
  The PwEevee release IPA with the integrated features and customizations.

- **Clean Decrypted Spotify 9.1.90** — `com.spotify.client_9.1.90_und3fined.ipa` (146.37 MB)  
  The clean, decrypted Spotify 9.1.90 IPA used as the base for PwEevee. It is decrypted but otherwise unmodified and does not include EeveeSpotify or other tweaks. It is provided separately for users who need the clean IPA for compatible tools such as Chroma.

## What's New

### Performance and Quality of Life

- Improved performance and responsiveness.
- Faster interactions and loading.
- Performance optimizations intended to reduce battery usage.
- General stability improvements and bug fixes.
- More requested features and quality-of-life settings.
- An option to disable automatic UI hiding.
- More ways to customize the app's navigation and appearance.

### Native Downloads — Pixie Download Manager

PwEevee integrates **Pixie Download Manager v1.3**, built on the Vitrine project and targeting Spotify 9.1.90.

- Native Spotify offline downloads for tracks, albums, and playlists.
- Download the album associated with the currently playing track directly from the manager.
- Redesigned download controls and album actions.
- Improved playlist and mix headers where Spotify provides both Add and Download controls.
- Download status and related diagnostics available through Vitrine settings.
- Offline-device management, including identifying the current registration and removing entries.
- Optional diagnostics, with a single action to export JSON diagnostic logs.
- English interface.

Downloads are stored in Spotify's offline storage for playback within Spotify. Exporting ordinary MP3, M4A, or OGG files is not implemented.

**Download performance:** The reported estimate is approximately 45–75 MB for around 100 songs, depending on the content and download conditions. Actual storage use can vary.

The native download integration is based on [[Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie](https://github.com/Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie)](https://github.com/Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie). Its published IPA download and update information are available through the [[project's Telegram post](https://t.me/glongqforks/5)](https://t.me/glongqforks/5). The repository contains source code and patches rather than hosted IPA files.

### Lyrics

- Word-by-word lyrics highlighting, with surrounding lines visually softened.
- Tap a lyric line to jump to that point in the song.
- Line-by-line translations.
- Lyrics translations into other languages when supported.
- Genius annotations for selected lyric lines.
- Improved Arabic and Hebrew text direction.
- Dedicated landscape lyrics layout, designed specifically for landscape rather than stretching the portrait interface.
- Return to portrait mode without losing your place in the player.
- Improved lock-screen lyrics presentation.

### Landscape Lyrics

- A dedicated full-screen landscape lyrics experience.
- Larger lyrics spanning the screen width.
- Controls that appear when touched.
- A layout designed specifically for landscape use.
- Returning to portrait restores the player experience.

### Sing and Vocal Controls

- Adjust vocal volume from full volume down to silent, where supported.
- Sing along with lyrics that remain synchronized with playback.
- With compatible AirPods and supported spatial-audio functionality, vocals can remain positioned in front of the listener as they turn their head.

Availability depends on device hardware, audio configuration, and feature support.

### Lock Screen Customization

- Lyrics displayed on the lock screen, with the current line updating during playback.
- Multiple lock-screen presentation styles.
- Animated cover support where available.
- More customization for the lock-screen artwork.

Additional styles may be possible through compatible customization tools, but unintegrated Workshop themes are not included in this release.

### Animated Album Artwork

- Animated album covers in the player and on album pages where supported.
- Improved presentation for animated artwork.
- Live Activity controls and information, where supported, including playback controls, queue information, or a sleep timer.
- Like and dislike actions from supported lock-screen controls.

### Artist Pages

- Improved artist-page presentation with prominent artwork and artist names.
- Easier access to liked songs from an artist.
- A more cohesive visual experience across supported artist pages.

### Web Player and Remote Viewing

The associated web-player functionality can show the currently playing content on another screen, including artwork and lyrics, where configured and supported.

- Open a link on a laptop or TV to view the current playback information.
- View word-by-word lyrics and animated artwork where supported.
- Keep audio playback on the phone.
- Browser-based controls are available only when enabled and permitted by the user.
- No additional installation is required on the viewing screen.

### Audio Controls and Effects

- Playback speed adjustment while preserving pitch where supported.
- Pitch adjustment while preserving tempo where supported.
- Reverb.
- Equalizer (EQ).
- Bass boost.
- Compander.
- Convolver.
- AutoEQ headphone correction.
- Customizable sound presets.

Example preset styles include Warm, Bass, Vocal, Electronic, and Late Night.

The availability and quality of individual effects may vary by device and implementation.

Credits and source information are listed below.

## Fixed Issues

- **App icon changes in LiveContainer:** Addressed the reported `Need an imageRef` exception. See [[Issue #1](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/1)](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/1).
- **Song downloads:** [Issue #2](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/2) was marked resolved. See [Issue #2](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/2).
- **Lock screen:** Fixed lock-screen bugs.
- Additional bug fixes and performance improvements.

## Website and Documentation

Website and documentation updates are included as part of PwEevee 3.1.0. These updates are part of the main release and do not constitute a separate website release.

Updates include documentation revisions, improved consistency across project pages, and updated project and download references where applicable.

## Compatibility and Known Issues

- **iOS 17.8.1:** PwEevee has been reported to launch successfully on an iPhone SE (2nd generation) with Developer Mode enabled. Spotify login and account registration encountered server errors on this device. This issue remains unresolved and is planned for investigation in a future update.
- **iOS 27.2 Developer Beta RC:** PwEevee has been tested on an iPhone 17 Pro Max, where the reported Spotify login and registration errors do not occur.
- **Testing coverage:** No other devices have been tested. Compatibility and runtime behavior may vary depending on iOS version, device, and installation method.
- **Pixie Download Manager:** The integration targets Spotify 9.1.90 and a specific Vitrine source revision. Other Spotify binaries require a separate compatibility port.
- **Jailbreak builds:** The linked Pixie jailbreak packages are from a previous release and have not been rebuilt from the v1.3 sources. The regular IPA has been tested through LiveContainer and SideStore; the jailbreak version has not been tested on a jailbroken device.
- Long-term offline license renewal has not been verified.

## Issue Tracking

- [[#1 — Crash When Changing the App Icon in LiveContainer](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/1)](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/1) — Reported as fixed.
- [[#2 — Can't Download Songs](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/2)](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/2) — Marked as resolved.
- [[#3 — Request for a Clean Decrypted Spotify 9.1.90 IPA](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/3)](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/3) — Closed as not planned because the request was considered outside the scope of PwEevee.

## Credits and Sources

- **PwEevee:** [[codeboy2012/PwEevee](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee)](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee)
- **Vitrine:** [[My-Name-Is-Jeff/vitrine](https://github.com/My-Name-Is-Jeff/vitrine)](https://github.com/My-Name-Is-Jeff/vitrine)
- **Pixie Download Manager:** [[Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie](https://github.com/Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie)](https://github.com/Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie)
- **Pixie IPA download and updates:** [[Glongq's Telegram post](https://t.me/glongqforks/5)](https://t.me/glongqforks/5)
- **Upstream spoti.pw:** [[skopevoj/spoti.pw](https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw)](https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw)
- **Previous download-manager work:** [[Glongq/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated](https://github.com/Glongq/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated)](https://github.com/Glongq/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated)

Vitrine retains credit for the base tweak and redesign. Pixie development, integration, and builds are credited to OpenAI Codex under Glongq's direction, with device testing and feedback from Glongq. Existing source notices and GPL-3.0 licensing information are retained in the [[Vitrine-Pixie repository](https://github.com/Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie/blob/main/LICENSE)](https://github.com/Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie/blob/main/LICENSE).

## Release Information

**Version:** 3.1.0  
**Release type:** Major feature release  
**Spotify base:** 9.1.90  
**Pixie Download Manager:** v1.3  
**Website:** Updates included in the main release; no separate website release.

Thank you to everyone who reported bugs, requested features, and contributed feedback. PwEevee 3.1.0 brings together a redesigned experience, richer lyrics and lock-screen features, audio customization, and native Spotify offline downloads.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/compare/v2.2.0-pre...3.1.0

# PwEevee v2.2.0-pre

### Unified SpoTi.pw + EeveeSpotify integration — pre-release

**Release channel:** Pre-release (device testing pending — please report issues, do not assume everything works)

---

## Overview

The first PwEevee build produced entirely by the unified, reproducible integration pipeline:

- **SpoTi.pw 0.22.0-alpha.2, rebuilt from source** in CI (macOS 15 + Theos, commit `94962d9`, run 39952230740) — not just a prebuilt binary pass-through.
- Combined with **EeveeSpotify 6.6.8-selfcontained.1** (upstream binary, byte-verified) into one package.
- **Complete PwEevee rebrand** of the user-facing surface, with upstream attribution preserved.

## What's new

### Exclusive premium settings
- `Spoof Premium` (SpoTi.pw) and `Eevee's Spoofed Premium` (EeveeSpotify) are mutually exclusive.
- Turning one on **grays out and disables** the other row immediately in the same settings view (Spot.pw-style UI behavior).
- Turning the active one off re-enables the other instantly; both may stay off; a legacy both-on state resolves deterministically.

### Change App Icons previews
- Every alternate-icon row now shows its **real logo preview** instead of a placeholder.
- Alternate-icon dictionaries validated for iPhone (`CFBundleIcons`) and iPad (`CFBundleIcons~ipad`) — 42 icons each.

### PwEevee rebrand & banner removal
- Titles, preference labels, About/credits, update check, donate row ("Support PwEevee"), lyrics provider identification and all user-facing URLs now name PwEevee (`github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee`, `https://pweevee.skytweak.dpdns.org/`).
- The **Discord promotional banner** is gone from Mod Settings, About and onboarding — no dead link, no reserved space.
- Update checks now query the PwEevee repository's GitHub Releases.
- Preserved on purpose: upstream attribution and license notices, on-device data paths (`spoti.pw/AdBlock`, `spoti.pw/Audio effects`, `spoti.pw/JamesDSP`, `spoti.pw/LockArtwork`) so installed users keep their libraries, and internal `spotifyglass` identifiers.

## Components

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| PwEevee | v2.2.0-pre (pre-release) |
| SpoTi.pw (spotifyglass) | 0.22.0-alpha.2 — from source |
| EeveeSpotify | 6.6.8-selfcontained.1 |
| Spotify base (IPA route) | 9.1.90, minimum iOS 16.1 |
| Spotify host (deb route) | 9.1.76 only |
| Bundled frameworks | CydiaSubstrate, Orion 1.0.2, EeveeSwiftProtobuf |

## Downloads

| Asset | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `PwEevee-0.22.0-alpha.2-unified-Spotify-9.1.90.ipa` | 287 MB | `a76b469a8291d6650026ef1355b77ead37efcc9250517aaf057a6e6b1dab3996` |
| `PwEevee_0.22.0-alpha.2_iphoneos-arm.deb` | 0.6 MB | `02448bf101b9ad887982e6c9c5620c811577287e5aa89ce476222854ccb5153c` |
| `PwEevee-v2.2.0-pre-validation-report.md` | — | `095b43d9b724cd6ebd296b4f2a0a46ca277b3f805b4335142ada88a96d177b8e` |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` covers every asset; full details are in the validation report.

## Installation

- **IPA route:** install with any sideload signer (IPA re-signs during install). Requires iOS 16.1 or newer.
- **deb route:** rootless jailbreak (Dopamine/roothide); host Spotify **9.1.76 only**.

## What is verified — and what is not

- Verified: the full test battery (build 7, deb-format 30, premium-exclusivity 47, eevee-settings 67, rebrand 30, deb 6, readme-updater 29 — 216 checks, all passing), pipeline Mach-O/structure validation, and end-to-end static probes of the shipped IPA and deb (33/33).
- **Not verified:** installation, app launch, playback, the settings UI on a real device, and the icon previews on screen. No device or simulator run was available for this build. Please file issues with device model, iOS version and signing method.

## Credits

PwEevee integrates the work of the upstream projects: **spoti.pw** (us) by Vojtěch Škopek — [github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw](https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw), **Chroma** — [chroma.pw](https://chroma.pw), and **EeveeSpotify** — [github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated). # PwEevee v2.1.0-pre
### EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 Integration — Experimental Pre-release

**Release channel:** Pre-release  
**Project:** PwEevee  
**Version:** v2.1.0-pre  
**Integrated tweak:** EeveeSpotify 7.0.0  
**Base Spotify version:** 9.1.88  
**Build identifier:** `com.skywatch.spotify`  
**Status:** Testing and compatibility verification pending

---

## Overview

PwEevee v2.1.0-pre is an experimental release focused on integrating EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 into a customized Spotify iOS build, with additional work aimed at improving Apple Watch compatibility.

This release uses Spotify 9.1.88 as its base and includes the EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 tweak package. It introduces a custom bundle identifier to accommodate the signing limitations encountered during development.

This build is being published as a pre-release to support testing, identify compatibility issues, and gather useful feedback before a verified release is made available.

**Important:** Successful installation, launch behavior, playback, EeveeSpotify functionality, free-account compatibility, and Apple Watch integration have not yet been fully verified. Do not assume these features are working until testing has been completed.

## What's Included

- Spotify 9.1.88 base IPA
- EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 integration
- Custom bundle identifier: `com.skywatch.spotify`
- Experimental Apple Watch compatibility work
- Updated build intended for further installation and compatibility testing

The final feature set and compatibility will be documented as testing progresses.

---

## ⚠️ Important Notice — Apple App ID Registration Limit

During development, the available App ID registrations on the signing account were exhausted.

The developer's reported account limit and usage are:

- **Reported App ID limit:** 10
- **Previously used registrations:** 3
- **Initially available registrations:** 7
- **Current status:** Available registrations exhausted during development

The previously used registrations were associated with SideStore, Spotify, and LiveContainer.

Because Apple signing could not register the original Spotify bundle identifier, `com.spotify.client`, this build uses the alternative identifier:

`com.skywatch.spotify`

### What This Means

Changing the bundle identifier can affect how iOS treats the app and how it interacts with other components.

- The modified app may install separately from the official Spotify app rather than replace it.
- Existing Spotify app data, settings, and Keychain items may not carry over.
- Features that depend on Spotify's original bundle identifier may behave differently.
- Apple Watch integration may require additional configuration and compatibility testing.
- Installation and launch behavior remain unverified.

The custom bundle identifier is a development workaround for the current signing limitation. It does not guarantee compatibility or successful operation.

---

## Build Information

| Component | Version / Details |
|---|---|
| PwEevee | v2.1.0-pre |
| EeveeSpotify | v7.0.0 |
| Base Spotify | v9.1.88 |
| Bundle identifier | `com.skywatch.spotify` |
| Release type | Experimental pre-release |

---

## Downloadable Assets

### 1. Original Spotify IPA

**Filename:** `com.spotify.client_9.1.88_und3fined.ipa`  
**Size:** 149.01 MB

The original decrypted Spotify 9.1.88 IPA used as the base for this build. This asset is provided as the unmodified base according to the development notes.

### 2. EeveeSpotify Tweak Package

**Filename:** `com.eevee.spotify_7.0.0_iphoneos-arm64.deb`  
**Size:** 2.42 MB

The EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 package used for the integration.

### 3. PwEevee / SkyWatch Build

**Filename:** `skywatch-spotify-9.1.88-watchfix.ipa`  
**Size:** 149.02 MB

The resulting custom IPA, built from the Spotify 9.1.88 base with EeveeSpotify 7.0.0.

The `watchfix` filename reflects the intended Apple Watch compatibility work. It should not be interpreted as confirmation that Apple Watch functionality has been successfully verified.

---

## Testing Status

All testing items below remain pending verification.

- [ ] IPA installation
- [ ] Successful app launch
- [ ] Playback functionality
- [ ] EeveeSpotify settings and features
- [ ] Apple Watch compatibility
- [ ] Stability and crash testing
- [ ] Compatibility with the custom bundle identifier

No feature should be considered verified until the corresponding test has been completed.

---

## Planned Verification

The next phase will focus on structured testing using Apple's development tools.

Planned testing includes:

- **Xcode iOS Simulator:** Initial compatibility investigation using an iPhone 18 Pro simulator configuration, where supported.
- **Apple Watch testing:** Investigation using an Apple Watch SE (3rd generation), 44 mm, with a compatible watchOS environment.
- **Installation and launch:** Confirming whether the build installs, opens, and remains stable.
- **Playback:** Checking basic playback and player behavior.
- **EeveeSpotify integration:** Testing settings and available customization features.
- **Free-account behavior:** Determining which features function with a free Spotify account.
- **Apple Watch integration:** Checking pairing, playback controls, and communication between the iPhone and Watch.

Simulator testing may not reproduce all behavior of a physical device. Features involving signing, provisioning, audio playback, Spotify services, or real Apple Watch connectivity may require additional testing on supported hardware.

A verified release will be published when sufficient testing has been completed and the results support the compatibility claims made in its release notes.

---

## Compatibility

Compatibility may vary depending on:

- iOS version
- Spotify base version
- Device and operating system configuration
- Signing and provisioning method
- Bundle identifier and entitlements
- Installed tweaks or other modifications
- Apple Watch and watchOS configuration

At this stage, compatibility with specific devices and software versions should be considered unconfirmed.

---

## Reporting Issues

Bug reports are welcome and can help identify issues before the verified release.

When submitting an issue, please include:

1. Device model
2. iOS version
3. Spotify base version
4. PwEevee release version
5. Signing or sideloading method
6. Whether the app installs and launches
7. Steps to reproduce the issue
8. Relevant crash logs, diagnostic output, or screenshots

Please avoid including personal information, account credentials, signing certificates, or provisioning profile secrets in public reports.

---

## Roadmap

Planned development priorities include:

- Completing initial installation and launch testing
- Investigating playback and feature compatibility
- Evaluating free-account behavior
- Testing Apple Watch compatibility
- Addressing reproducible bugs
- Improving compatibility documentation
- Publishing a verified release when testing is sufficient
- Continuing development and adding further improvements in future versions

Additional updates and builds may follow as development and testing progress.

---

## Disclaimer

PwEevee is an unofficial community project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Spotify or Apple.

This is an experimental pre-release provided for testing and development purposes. Compatibility and functionality are not guaranteed.

Use only software and accounts you are authorized to use, and review the relevant project licenses and service terms before distributing or installing modified builds.

**Current recommendation:** Treat v2.1.0-pre as an unverified testing build. A verified release will be announced separately after the planned testing has been completed.

# PwEevee v2.0.0

> **Major Release — EeveeSpotify 7.0.0**

PwEevee **v2.0.0** is a major update that brings the project to the new **EeveeSpotify 7.0.0** generation, with a large number of new features, a redesigned experience, Liquid Glass support, Spotify version spoofing, and many stability and UI improvements.

This release is a **major overhaul** from the previous v1.x builds.

## ⭐ Recommended Build

### `EeveeSpotifyv7.0.0.ipa`

**154 MB — 161,793,103 bytes**

This is the **recommended PwEevee build**.

It provides the new EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 experience while avoiding the additional restrictions introduced by the newer SpoTi.pw releases.

### Highlights

-  EeveeSpotify **7.0.0**
-  **Liquid Glass** support
-  Redesigned settings experience
-  Updated customization system
-  Enhanced lyrics and karaoke features
-  Custom lyrics improvements
-  Tab customization
-  Appearance customization
-  Player customization
-  App flag tool
-  Privacy and stability improvements
-  Updated iOS 26/27 experience
-  Major underlying updates from previous versions

**This is the build we recommend for most users.**

---

## Optional Combined Build

### `SpoTiv50.0.0+EeveeSpotifyv7.0.0.ipa`

**133 MB — 139,507,438 bytes**

This build combines:

- **SpoTi.pw 0.50.0**
- **EeveeSpotify 7.0.0**

It provides a larger portion of the functionality available through the SpoTi.pw + EeveeSpotify combination.

However, **this build is optional and is not our primary recommendation**.

The newer SpoTi.pw releases have introduced paid/premium functionality, so users looking for the best free experience should generally use the **EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 build** instead.

> **Important:** The combined build does **not** contain every feature from SpoTi.pw 0.50.0.

---

## Why EeveeSpotify Is Recommended

PwEevee's goal is to provide a powerful Spotify customization experience without requiring users to rely on paid functionality.

The standalone EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 build already provides a substantial feature set, including:

- Liquid Glass
- Spotify version spoofing
- Advanced appearance customization
- Tab customization
- Custom lyrics
- Karaoke / lyrics enhancements
- Player customization
- Remote feature flags
- Extensive settings customization
- Privacy and stability improvements

For most users, **EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 is the build to install.**

---

## Version Information

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| **PwEevee** | **v2.0.0** |
| **EeveeSpotify** | **v7.0.0** |
| **SpoTi.pw** | **v0.50.0** *(combined build only)* |
| **Primary build** | EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 |
| **Combined build** | SpoTi.pw 0.50.0 + EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 |

---

##  Important

PwEevee v2.0.0 is a major release and has undergone significant changes from v1.x.

Compatibility can vary depending on:

- Spotify version
- iOS version
- Device
- Sideloading method
- Signing environment
- Installed tweaks
- Whether the combined build is being used

If you encounter an issue, please include:

1. Your iOS version
2. Your Spotify version
3. Which PwEevee IPA you installed
4. Your signing/sideloading method
5. What happened
6. Any relevant crash or installation logs

---

## Downloads

###  Recommended

**`EeveeSpotifyv7.0.0.ipa`**

EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 standalone build with Liquid Glass, Spotify version spoofing, customization features, lyrics enhancements, and the updated EeveeSpotify experience.

### Optional

**`SpoTiv50.0.0+EeveeSpotifyv7.0.0.ipa`**

Combined SpoTi.pw 0.50.0 + EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 build.

> **Recommendation:** Start with the standalone EeveeSpotify 7.0.0 build.

---

## What's New in v2.0.0

This release represents a major evolution of PwEevee.

The project has moved from the older v1.x integration toward the significantly newer **EeveeSpotify 7.0.0** codebase, bringing a redesigned interface, Liquid Glass support, Spotify version spoofing, expanded customization, improved lyrics functionality, remote configuration capabilities, and numerous stability improvements.

**v2.0.0 is the recommended starting point for new PwEevee users.**

# PwEevee 3.1.0 — Major Feature Release

PwEevee 3.1.0 is a major feature release focused on performance, customization, lyrics, lock-screen improvements, audio features, and downloads. Built around Spotify **9.1.90**, this release brings together requested features, improvements from the Vitrine project, and Pixie Download Manager's native Spotify offline-download functionality.

## Downloads

- **PwEevee 3.1.0** — `PwEevee-3.1.0.ipa` (140.23 MB)  
  The PwEevee release IPA with the integrated features and customizations.

- **Clean Decrypted Spotify 9.1.90** — `com.spotify.client_9.1.90_und3fined.ipa` (146.37 MB)  
  The clean, decrypted Spotify 9.1.90 IPA used as the base for PwEevee. It is decrypted but otherwise unmodified and does not include EeveeSpotify or other tweaks. It is provided separately for users who need the clean IPA for compatible tools such as Chroma.

## What's New

### Performance and Quality of Life

- Improved performance and responsiveness.
- Faster interactions and loading.
- Performance optimizations intended to reduce battery usage.
- General stability improvements and bug fixes.
- More requested features and quality-of-life settings.
- An option to disable automatic UI hiding.
- More ways to customize the app's navigation and appearance.

### Native Downloads — Pixie Download Manager

PwEevee integrates **Pixie Download Manager v1.3**, built on the Vitrine project and targeting Spotify 9.1.90.

- Native Spotify offline downloads for tracks, albums, and playlists.
- Download the album associated with the currently playing track directly from the manager.
- Redesigned download controls and album actions.
- Improved playlist and mix headers where Spotify provides both Add and Download controls.
- Download status and related diagnostics available through Vitrine settings.
- Offline-device management, including identifying the current registration and removing entries.
- Optional diagnostics, with a single action to export JSON diagnostic logs.
- English interface.

Downloads are stored in Spotify's offline storage for playback within Spotify. Exporting ordinary MP3, M4A, or OGG files is not implemented.

**Download performance:** The reported estimate is approximately 45–75 MB for around 100 songs, depending on the content and download conditions. Actual storage use can vary.

The native download integration is based on [[Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie](https://github.com/Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie)](https://github.com/Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie). Its published IPA download and update information are available through the [[project's Telegram post](https://t.me/glongqforks/5)](https://t.me/glongqforks/5). The repository contains source code and patches rather than hosted IPA files.

### Lyrics

- Word-by-word lyrics highlighting, with surrounding lines visually softened.
- Tap a lyric line to jump to that point in the song.
- Line-by-line translations.
- Lyrics translations into other languages when supported.
- Genius annotations for selected lyric lines.
- Improved Arabic and Hebrew text direction.
- Dedicated landscape lyrics layout, designed specifically for landscape rather than stretching the portrait interface.
- Return to portrait mode without losing your place in the player.
- Improved lock-screen lyrics presentation.

### Landscape Lyrics

- A dedicated full-screen landscape lyrics experience.
- Larger lyrics spanning the screen width.
- Controls that appear when touched.
- A layout designed specifically for landscape use.
- Returning to portrait restores the player experience.

### Sing and Vocal Controls

- Adjust vocal volume from full volume down to silent, where supported.
- Sing along with lyrics that remain synchronized with playback.
- With compatible AirPods and supported spatial-audio functionality, vocals can remain positioned in front of the listener as they turn their head.

Availability depends on device hardware, audio configuration, and feature support.

### Lock Screen Customization

- Lyrics displayed on the lock screen, with the current line updating during playback.
- Multiple lock-screen presentation styles.
- Animated cover support where available.
- More customization for the lock-screen artwork.

Additional styles may be possible through compatible customization tools, but unintegrated Workshop themes are not included in this release.

### Animated Album Artwork

- Animated album covers in the player and on album pages where supported.
- Improved presentation for animated artwork.
- Live Activity controls and information, where supported, including playback controls, queue information, or a sleep timer.
- Like and dislike actions from supported lock-screen controls.

### Artist Pages

- Improved artist-page presentation with prominent artwork and artist names.
- Easier access to liked songs from an artist.
- A more cohesive visual experience across supported artist pages.

### Web Player and Remote Viewing

The associated web-player functionality can show the currently playing content on another screen, including artwork and lyrics, where configured and supported.

- Open a link on a laptop or TV to view the current playback information.
- View word-by-word lyrics and animated artwork where supported.
- Keep audio playback on the phone.
- Browser-based controls are available only when enabled and permitted by the user.
- No additional installation is required on the viewing screen.

### Audio Controls and Effects

- Playback speed adjustment while preserving pitch where supported.
- Pitch adjustment while preserving tempo where supported.
- Reverb.
- Equalizer (EQ).
- Bass boost.
- Compander.
- Convolver.
- AutoEQ headphone correction.
- Customizable sound presets.

Example preset styles include Warm, Bass, Vocal, Electronic, and Late Night.

The availability and quality of individual effects may vary by device and implementation.

Credits and source information are listed below.

## Fixed Issues

- **App icon changes in LiveContainer:** Addressed the reported `Need an imageRef` exception. See [[Issue #1](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/1)](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/1).
- **Song downloads:** [Issue #2](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/2) was marked resolved. See [Issue #2](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/2).
- **Lock screen:** Fixed lock-screen bugs.
- Additional bug fixes and performance improvements.

## Website and Documentation

Website and documentation updates are included as part of PwEevee 3.1.0. These updates are part of the main release and do not constitute a separate website release.

Updates include documentation revisions, improved consistency across project pages, and updated project and download references where applicable.

## Compatibility and Known Issues

- **iOS 17.8.1:** PwEevee has been reported to launch successfully on an iPhone SE (2nd generation) with Developer Mode enabled. Spotify login and account registration encountered server errors on this device. This issue remains unresolved and is planned for investigation in a future update.
- **iOS 27.2 Developer Beta RC:** PwEevee has been tested on an iPhone 17 Pro Max, where the reported Spotify login and registration errors do not occur.
- **Testing coverage:** No other devices have been tested. Compatibility and runtime behavior may vary depending on iOS version, device, and installation method.
- **Pixie Download Manager:** The integration targets Spotify 9.1.90 and a specific Vitrine source revision. Other Spotify binaries require a separate compatibility port.
- **Jailbreak builds:** The linked Pixie jailbreak packages are from a previous release and have not been rebuilt from the v1.3 sources. The regular IPA has been tested through LiveContainer and SideStore; the jailbreak version has not been tested on a jailbroken device.
- Long-term offline license renewal has not been verified.

## Issue Tracking

- [[#1 — Crash When Changing the App Icon in LiveContainer](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/1)](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/1) — Reported as fixed.
- [[#2 — Can't Download Songs](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/2)](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/2) — Marked as resolved.
- [[#3 — Request for a Clean Decrypted Spotify 9.1.90 IPA](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/3)](https://github.com/codeboy2012/PwEevee/issues/3) — Closed as not planned because the request was considered outside the scope of PwEevee.

- **Upstream spoti.pw:** [[skopevoj/spoti.pw](https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw)](https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw)

Vitrine retains credit for the base tweak and redesign. Pixie development, integration, and builds are credited to OpenAI Codex under Glongq's direction, with device testing and feedback from Glongq. Existing source notices and GPL-3.0 licensing information are retained in the [[Vitrine-Pixie repository](https://github.com/Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie/blob/main/LICENSE)](https://github.com/Glongq/Vitrine-Pixie/blob/main/LICENSE).

## Release Information

**Version:** 3.1.0  
**Release type:** Major feature release  
**Spotify base:** 9.1.90  
**Pixie Download Manager:** v1.3  
**Website:** Updates included in the main release; no separate website release.

Thank you to everyone who reported bugs, requested features, and contributed feedback. PwEevee 3.1.0 brings together a redesigned experience, richer lyrics and lock-screen features, audio customization, and native Spotify offline downloads.

# EeveeSpotify 7.0.0

A ground-up overhaul of the tweak's interface, built around native **iOS 26 Liquid Glass**, plus a redesigned settings app, a remote flag browser, and a large batch of stability and privacy fixes.
---

## ✨ Liquid Glass UI *(iOS 26)*

A new opt-in rendering layer that replaces Spotify's stock chrome with real system glass, toggleable surface-by-surface — take the tab bar without touching the player.

- **Tab bar** — a genuine `UITabBar` rendered as native glass, with taps replayed onto Spotify's own tab items
- **Now Playing bar** — glass capsule with album-colour tinting
- **Spotify's own bars & menus** — existing blur views swapped for real `UIGlassEffect`
- **Player, lyrics, search, home, and page headers**
- **Playlist, album, and artist** glass action rows, with header and Home section controls
- **Custom lyrics view** — optional glass rendering, with the button hidden automatically when no lyrics are fetched

## 🎛️ Tab bar customization

Reorder tabs, hide tabs you never tap, hide labels for an icon-only bar, choose a launch tab, and pin any Spotify page as a custom tab. Liked Songs, Downloads, Podcasts, and Queue ship as presets; any `spotify:` URI can be added. Custom tabs navigate in-app rather than bouncing to your other Spotify install.

## 🎨 Appearance

- **AMOLED black theme** — see [Credits](#-credits) below
- **Custom accent colours** and **custom background colours**
- **Rounded playlist cover art** for library rows and playlist track rows
- **Dynamic background colours** pulled from album art
- **Home gradient control** — style (gradient or solid), height (short, medium, tall), strength, fade curve, and per-page targeting for Home, Library, and Search
- **Player backdrop** and **glass lyrics card** toggles

## 🎧 Player

Control decluttering, double-tap seek/skip zones, haptics for buttons and scrubbing, and direct access to Word-Synced lyrics.

## 📜 Lyrics & karaoke

The biggest change here: **word-synced lyrics now work in the custom lyrics view**, not just on Spotify's own lyrics screen.

- **Word-synced support for the custom lyrics view**, with a dedicated on/off toggle gating the rest of the section
- **Customisable blur intensity** (0–6) for inactive lyric lines
- **Other lyrics sources can now use line-synced mode**, not just Spicy Lyrics
- **Credits footer** with real attribution — who wrote, provided, and uploaded the lyrics
- **Official Spicy Lyrics API** with a configurable key, in-app validation, and a link to the key template
- Lyrics uncensoring fill, RTL karaoke highlighting, text alignment and reversed-direction controls

## 🔧 New settings surfaces

- **Remote flag browser** — browse, search, and override Spotify's server-side feature flags, with change-only filtering and per-flag reset
- **Curated Spotify Features page** — hidden switches Spotify already ships (trim silence, library Pro, denser rows, lock-screen options, sleep timer, and more)
- **Redesigned settings** grouped into Listening / Looks / Advanced, with per-page previews, page-level resets, and a Troubleshooting section
- **Debug logging** with export and clear

## 🛡️ Privacy & stability

- **Blocks third-party tracking SDKs** — Firebase, Facebook, Branch, and other analytics
- **Hide Jam** — strips Jam entry points from the app without touching tracks or artists that happen to be titled "Jam"
- **Blocks App Store rating prompts** — no more review popups interrupting playback
- Resolves an access-token race crash, a karaoke long-press scope bug, settings tint leaks, and assorted stability issues

---

## 🐛 Fixes in this release

### Custom lyrics view didn't update between songs

The biggest fix. Previously, opening the custom lyrics view pinned it to whatever song was playing at that moment — skip to the next track and it kept showing the old lyrics until you closed and reopened it.

It now follows the player: when the track changes, it swaps in the new song's lyrics and resets scroll position and per-line state so each song starts fresh. If the new track's lyrics aren't in hand yet, it fetches them and retries a few times before giving up.

It also tracks the **actually playing** track rather than the one a lyrics request last named — Spotify preloads lyrics for upcoming songs, so the old behaviour could latch onto the wrong one. If no lyrics turn up at all, the view closes itself instead of sitting there empty.

### iPad Liquid Glass layout

- **Tab bar rendered too small** — the glass bar inherited Spotify's short iPad strip height, squashing every item. Now floored at 50pt and centred on the original strip.
- **Album art escaped the mini player** — clipping was applied inside a radius check that iPad's capsule radius skipped entirely, so artwork bled past the corners. Clipping is now unconditional, and the artwork search is iPad-aware.

### Localisations

- Non-English tables brought in line with English
- Version appearance simplified, build number surfaced in-app
- "Rounded artwork" renamed to **"Rounded playlist cover art"** across all 27 languages

---

## 📦 Packaging

Locally built IPAs now ship with the alternate app icons baked in, and the deb dependency was corrected.

---

## 📋 At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| Minimum iOS | **16.1** |
| Liquid Glass | iOS 26 + restart |
| Languages | **27** |
| Alternate app icons | **34** |
| Spotify | 9.1.x |

---

## 📥 Install

Sign the IPA with **SideStore**, **FlareStore**, or a certificate-based signer like **RyukSign**. For jailbroken devices, grab the `.deb` matching your architecture from the releases page.

---

## 🙏 Credits

This release stands on a lot of contributed work. Thank you to everyone who opened a PR, reported an issue, or tested a build.

### Hide Jam & block rating prompts

**Hide Jam** and **Block rating prompts** were proposed and implemented by **[Incognito-Coder](https://github.com/Incognito-Coder)** in **[PR #152](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/152)** (*feat: hide Jam from menus and block app star rating dialogs*).

**Hide Jam** strips Jam out of the app without touching tracks or artists that happen to be titled "Jam" — it overrides 17 Jam-related remote configuration flags covering the queue button, guest controls, device-picker integration, nearby-session nudges, invite deep links, and local-network discovery. Rating prompts are suppressed by hooking `SKStoreReviewController` directly.

Both are off by default and take effect after restarting Spotify.

### AMOLED black theme

The optional **AMOLED black theme** was originally proposed and implemented by **[nodzen](https://github.com/nodzen)** in **[PR #126](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/126)** (*feat: add optional AMOLED black theme*).

Rather than flattening every dark surface to pure black, nodzen's approach was surgical: it replaces only opaque, nearly neutral dark `UIView` backgrounds with true black, while deliberately preserving coloured artwork-derived backgrounds, gradients, translucent materials, text, icons, and shadows. That constraint is what keeps the theme from destroying album art and glass surfaces elsewhere in the app.

The theme ships disabled by default and takes effect after restarting Spotify.

### Word-synced lyrics

**Word-synced lyrics in the custom lyrics view**

### Other contributions

- **[hooray804](https://github.com/hooray804)** — Korean localisation ([PR #172](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/172))
- **[marcinmajsc](https://github.com/marcinmajsc)** — Polish localisation and lyrics source footer ([PR #123](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/123), [PR #147](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/147))
- **[Huseyin-Korkmaz](https://github.com/Huseyin-Korkmaz)** — Turkish localisation ([PR #137](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/137))
- **[U-rTrDD-fyi](https://github.com/U-rTrDD-fyi)** — Musixmatch lyrics fix for the `apic` ELB 403 ([PR #166](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/166))
- **[karlfrank916](https://github.com/karlfrank916)** — the Messages `si` parameter report that prompted this release's share-link investigation ([#171](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/issues/171))

---

## Known issues

- **Share links to Messages still include Spotify's `si` tracking parameter** ([#171](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/issues/171)). Clean Share Links strips it for the share sheet, clipboard, and direct share targets, but the Messages route isn't covered yet. An attempted fix was reverted because it targeted a class we couldn't confirm on that code path.

---

Made by @SideloadLabs:
@jaydenjcpy
@faroukbmiled 
@M0d-4

## ✨ Liquid Glass UI *(iOS 26)*

A new opt-in rendering layer that replaces Spotify's stock chrome with real system glass, toggleable surface-by-surface — take the tab bar without touching the player.

- **Tab bar** — a genuine `UITabBar` rendered as native glass, with taps replayed onto Spotify's own tab items
- **Now Playing bar** — glass capsule with album-colour tinting
- **Spotify's own bars & menus** — existing blur views swapped for real `UIGlassEffect`
- **Player, lyrics, search, home, and page headers**
- **Playlist, album, and artist** glass action rows, with header and Home section controls
- **Custom lyrics view** — optional glass rendering, with the button hidden automatically when no lyrics are fetched

## 🎛️ Tab bar customization

Reorder tabs, hide tabs you never tap, hide labels for an icon-only bar, choose a launch tab, and pin any Spotify page as a custom tab. Liked Songs, Downloads, Podcasts, and Queue ship as presets; any `spotify:` URI can be added. Custom tabs navigate in-app rather than bouncing to your other Spotify install.

## 🎨 Appearance

- **AMOLED black theme** — see [Credits](#-credits) below
- **Custom accent colours** and **custom background colours**
- **Rounded playlist cover art** for library rows and playlist track rows
- **Dynamic background colours** pulled from album art
- **Home gradient control** — style (gradient or solid), height (short, medium, tall), strength, fade curve, and per-page targeting for Home, Library, and Search
- **Player backdrop** and **glass lyrics card** toggles

## 🎧 Player

Control decluttering, double-tap seek/skip zones, haptics for buttons and scrubbing, and direct access to Word-Synced lyrics.

## 📜 Lyrics & karaoke

The biggest change here: **word-synced lyrics now work in the custom lyrics view**, not just on Spotify's own lyrics screen.

- **Word-synced support for the custom lyrics view**, with a dedicated on/off toggle gating the rest of the section
- **Customisable blur intensity** (0–6) for inactive lyric lines
- **Other lyrics sources can now use line-synced mode**, not just Spicy Lyrics
- **Credits footer** with real attribution — who wrote, provided, and uploaded the lyrics
- **Official Spicy Lyrics API** with a configurable key, in-app validation, and a link to the key template
- Lyrics uncensoring fill, RTL karaoke highlighting, text alignment and reversed-direction controls

## 🔧 New settings surfaces

- **Remote flag browser** — browse, search, and override Spotify's server-side feature flags, with change-only filtering and per-flag reset
- **Curated Spotify Features page** — hidden switches Spotify already ships (trim silence, library Pro, denser rows, lock-screen options, sleep timer, and more)
- **Redesigned settings** grouped into Listening / Looks / Advanced, with per-page previews, page-level resets, and a Troubleshooting section
- **Debug logging** with export and clear

## 🛡️ Privacy & stability

- **Blocks third-party tracking SDKs** — Firebase, Facebook, Branch, and other analytics
- **Hide Jam** — strips Jam entry points from the app without touching tracks or artists that happen to be titled "Jam"
- **Blocks App Store rating prompts** — no more review popups interrupting playback
- Resolves an access-token race crash, a karaoke long-press scope bug, settings tint leaks, and assorted stability issues

## 🐛 Fixes in this release

### Custom lyrics view didn't update between songs

The biggest fix. Previously, opening the custom lyrics view pinned it to whatever song was playing at that moment — skip to the next track and it kept showing the old lyrics until you closed and reopened it.

It now follows the player: when the track changes, it swaps in the new song's lyrics and resets scroll position and per-line state so each song starts fresh. If the new track's lyrics aren't in hand yet, it fetches them and retries a few times before giving up.

It also tracks the **actually playing** track rather than the one a lyrics request last named — Spotify preloads lyrics for upcoming songs, so the old behaviour could latch onto the wrong one. If no lyrics turn up at all, the view closes itself instead of sitting there empty.

### iPad Liquid Glass layout

- **Tab bar rendered too small** — the glass bar inherited Spotify's short iPad strip height, squashing every item. Now floored at 50pt and centred on the original strip.
- **Album art escaped the mini player** — clipping was applied inside a radius check that iPad's capsule radius skipped entirely, so artwork bled past the corners. Clipping is now unconditional, and the artwork search is iPad-aware.

### Localisations

- Non-English tables brought in line with English
- Version appearance simplified, build number surfaced in-app
- "Rounded artwork" renamed to **"Rounded playlist cover art"** across all 27 languages

## 🙏 Credits

This release stands on a lot of contributed work. Thank you to everyone who opened a PR, reported an issue, or tested a build.

### Hide Jam & block rating prompts

**Hide Jam** and **Block rating prompts** were proposed and implemented by **[Incognito-Coder](https://github.com/Incognito-Coder)** in **[PR #152](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/152)** (*feat: hide Jam from menus and block app star rating dialogs*).

**Hide Jam** strips Jam out of the app without touching tracks or artists that happen to be titled "Jam" — it overrides 17 Jam-related remote configuration flags covering the queue button, guest controls, device-picker integration, nearby-session nudges, invite deep links, and local-network discovery. Rating prompts are suppressed by hooking `SKStoreReviewController` directly.

Both are off by default and take effect after restarting Spotify.

### AMOLED black theme

The optional **AMOLED black theme** was originally proposed and implemented by **[nodzen](https://github.com/nodzen)** in **[PR #126](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/126)** (*feat: add optional AMOLED black theme*).

Rather than flattening every dark surface to pure black, nodzen's approach was surgical: it replaces only opaque, nearly neutral dark `UIView` backgrounds with true black, while deliberately preserving coloured artwork-derived backgrounds, gradients, translucent materials, text, icons, and shadows. That constraint is what keeps the theme from destroying album art and glass surfaces elsewhere in the app.

The theme ships disabled by default and takes effect after restarting Spotify.
